items.title: Motorola Solutions (NYSE:MSI) posts better-than-expected sales in Q3 2026 but quarterly revenue guidance slightly misses expectations
items.summary: Public safety technology company Motorola Solutions (NYSE:MSI) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue rising 12.2% year on year to $3.38 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $3.82 billion was less impressive, coming in 1.3% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.69 per share was 5.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
